string-array.name: daily_reminder_messages
string-array.item: The Rat King is gathering his guards. Reach him before reinforcements arrive.
Tengu is escaping. Break through the prison and stop him.
Three miners are trapped. Bring them back before the last lift leaves.
Three beasts roam the ice caves. Hunt them down before the storm closes in.
Demons are coming through the ritual sites. Seal all three.
The outpost is under attack. Hold it until help arrives.
The King\'s gold is behind locked doors. Take it and get out before the gates close.
